## Experience

- Software Engineer at Embreo PTE Ltd since September 2021: NestJS microservices migrated from a running monolith, payments through HitPay, Stripe and Airwallex, and an AWS deploy pipeline.
- Technical Mentor and Systems Consultant at SMK Negeri 12 Jakarta since June 2021: mentoring for national developer certifications and school server operations.
- Freelance Software Engineer, August 2019 to February 2020: client websites from database to frontend with PHP and CodeIgniter.
- B.Sc. Computer Science, evening classes, in progress.

## Projects

- Cara.sg — Full-stack Engineer. Membership app for the dementia community in Singapore: Safe Return, missing-person alerts, rewards, Mandarin support. React, NestJS, Expo, MySQL, Redis.
- Affluent.sg — Full-stack Engineer. Wills and estate-planning platform for Singapore families, with encrypted client data and HitPay payments. React, Express, MySQL.
- JebHealth — Full-stack Engineer. HealthTech marketplace for SG, MY, TH and VN, plus health-fintech cards with Stripe and Airwallex. Express, React, Expo.
- LVE Gym — Full-stack Engineer. Booking app for boutique gyms: class schedules, packs, personal training and live heart rate over Bluetooth. React, NestJS, Expo, BLE.
- Pinknode — Frontend Engineer. Dashboard for a Polkadot node-as-a-service: API usage analytics and account management. React.
